events.title: Frankfurt Wäldchestag — Forest Day Tradition
events.description: Frankfurt's unique 'Forest Day' tradition dating back to the 16th century. On the Tuesday after Whitsun, the entire city heads to the Stadtwald (city forest) for a public holiday celebration. Food stalls, beer gardens, traditional music, and dancing in the forest. Frankfurter's most beloved local tradition — schools and many offices close.

events.title: Mainfest Frankfurt
events.description: Frankfurt's traditional three-day summer festival on the banks of the Main River. Carnival rides, live music stages, regional food specialties (Handkäse, Grüne Soße, Frankfurter Würstchen, Apfelwein), artisan market, and a spectacular fireworks display over the river on Saturday evening. Family-friendly all weekend.
events.location: Mainkai, along Main River between Friedensbrücke and Untermainbrücke, Frankfurt

events.title: Freiluftkino Frankfurt (Open Air Cinema)
events.description: Frankfurt's summer open-air cinema screens highlights of the past film year in the courtyard of the former police headquarters. Running from 26 June to 23 August 2026, admission starts at 19:30 with screenings beginning after dusk. Organized by the Lichter Filmfestival since 2020.
events.location: Altes Polizeipräsidium, Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage 5-11, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurt Jazz Festival
events.description: International jazz festival across multiple Frankfurt venues. From intimate club sessions at the legendary Jazzkeller to open-air concerts along the Main riverbanks. Features Grammy-winning headliners, European avant-garde artists, and emerging local talent. Late-night jam sessions every evening.
events.location: Various venues across Frankfurt (Jazzkeller, HR-Sendesaal, Mainufer)

events.title: Frankfurt Dippemess — Traditional Funfair
events.description: Frankfurt's historic funfair dating back to the 14th century. Roller coasters, thrill rides, bumper cars, shooting galleries, candy floss, and traditional fairground games. The name 'Dippemess' comes from the pottery (Dippe) that was traditionally sold here. A beloved Frankfurt tradition for all ages.

events.title: Frankfurter Apfelweinfest
events.description: Frankfurt's iconic apple-wine festival transforms the Roßmarkt into a celebration of the region's 'Stöffche' with dozens of stands, live music, Hessian specialties and apple-wine tastings against the skyline. The event runs from 7 to 16 August 2026, with extended hours until 00:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Entry is free; food and drink are paid.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; food & drink from ~5 EUR

events.title: Bernemer Kerb (Bornheimer Kerb)
events.description: Frankfurt-Bornheim celebrates its traditional parish fair with rides, food stalls and live music around the Hohen Brunnen fountain and along Berger Straße. The festival runs from 7 to 12 August 2026, opening with the Blues & Folk Night on 7 August. A beloved village-festival atmosphere in the heart of the city.

events.title: Mainz Wine Market & Regional Food Fair
events.description: Mainz showcases its finest regional wines and cuisine on the scenic Rhine promenade. Over 40 winemakers from Rheinhessen, Germany's largest wine region. Regional specialties like Spundekäs, Weck, Worscht un Woi (Mainz's signature snack). Live jazz and folk music.

events.title: Apfelwein Festival — Frankfurt's Signature Drink Celebration
events.description: Celebrate Frankfurt's beloved apple wine (Apfelwein) in Alt-Sachsenhausen. Sample dozens of local Apfelwein varieties from traditional producers, enjoy hearty Frankfurter cuisine (Handkäse mit Musik, Rippchen mit Kraut), listen to live folk and Schlager music, and learn about the 400-year-old tradition of Ebbelwei.

events.title: Mainz Summer Night Market on the Rhine
events.description: A magical night market on the banks of the Rhine in Mainz. Handcrafted goods, local art, jewelry, fashion pop-ups, vinyl records, and street food. Fairy lights, acoustic live music, and a relaxed summer evening atmosphere.

events.title: FILMZ Freiluftkino im Landesmuseum Mainz
events.description: Ten open-air cinema evenings in the courtyard of the Landesmuseum Mainz, programmed by the FILMZ festival, run from mid-August to 6 September 2026. Films from around the world are screened under the late-summer sky with drinks and popcorn. Tickets available in advance online.

events.title: Eintracht Frankfurt vs. Bundesliga Season Opener
events.description: Bundesliga season opener at Deutsche Bank Park. Experience the electric atmosphere of 51,500 passionate Eintracht Frankfurt fans. Pre-match fan zone with live music, food stalls, and family activities in the stadium grounds.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt

events.title: Museumsuferfest — Frankfurt's Biggest Cultural Festival
events.description: Frankfurt's biggest cultural festival along the Museumsufer riverbank. Over 30 museums open their doors with special exhibitions, behind-the-scenes tours, and hands-on activities. Live music on multiple stages across the riverbanks, international food stalls, dance performances, artist workshops, and a grand fireworks finale over the Main River. Attracts over 3 million visitors annually.
events.cost_per_person: Free (museum entry fees vary €4-€12, combined ticket €20)
events.location: Museumsufer, along both sides of Main River, Frankfurt

events.title: Mainzer Weinmarkt – Weekend 1
events.description: Rheinhessen's largest wine festival fills the Mainzer Stadtpark with around 100 winemakers, regional food and live music in a romantic Rosengarten setting. Weekend one runs 27-30 August 2026, ahead of a second long weekend in September. Around 300,000 visitors attend across both weekends.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; wine glasses & tasting from ~4 EUR

events.title: Museumsuferfest Frankfurt
events.description: One of Europe's largest cultural festivals along both banks of the Main, with over 25 museums, 12 stages and some 400 stands of art, music, international food and crafts. Dragon-boat races on the Main and a grand musical fireworks finale on Sunday evening are the highlights. Runs 28-30 August 2026.
events.cost_per_person: Free; museum button ~7 EUR for museum entry

events.title: Städel Museum: Elmgreen & Dragset „Stillleben mit Gemüse“
events.description: A major solo exhibition by the artist duo Elmgreen & Dragset at the Städel, on view from 20 May 2026 to 17 January 2027. The work transforms the museum's rooms with large-scale sculptural installations and charged still lifes. Open for visit throughout the August-October period.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle: „The World Through AI“
events.description: The Schirn's major summer exhibition shows artworks of the last ten years engaging with the cognitive, political and ecological dimensions of artificial intelligence. On view at the Schirn's interim location in Bockenheim from 11 June to 20 September 2026. A landmark look at art in the age of machine learning.
events.location: Schirn Kunsthalle (Interim Bockenheim), Niddastraße 74, 60329 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Senckenberg Naturmuseum: Sonderausstellung „Stadtinsekten“
events.description: The Senckenberg Nature Museum in Frankfurt presents a special exhibition on the insects that share our cities, exploring urban ecosystems and biodiversity. The permanent dinosaur and natural-history collections remain a family favourite. Open throughout the autumn.
events.location: Senckenberg Naturmuseum, Senckenberganlage 25, 60325 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival – Konzerte rund um Mainz
events.description: The Rheingau Musik Festival runs from 20 June to early September 2026, offering 158 concerts at 26 venues across the region including Wiesbaden, Mainz and the Rheingau. Classical highlights with international stars such as The King's Singers, VOCES8 and Hayato Sumino close the season in late summer.
events.location: Various venues around Mainz and Wiesbaden

events.title: Museumsuferfest – Großes Abschlussfeuerwerk
events.description: The finale of the Museumsuferfest on Sunday 30 August 2026 is the grand musical fireworks display over the Main, seen best from both riverbanks. Earlier in the day, dragon-boat races draw crowds to the river. A spectacular end to three days of culture and celebration.
events.location: Mainufer along Museumsufer, 60594 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Mainzer Weinmarkt – Weekend 2
events.description: The second weekend of the Mainzer Weinmarkt runs from 3 to 6 September 2026 in the Stadtpark, featuring the same celebrated stands, live stages and a special anniversary of '90 Jahre Alt-Mainzer Stadtsoldaten'. Visitors can sample wines from Mainz, Rheinhessen, Rheingau and Nahe.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; wine tasting from ~4 EUR

events.title: Goethe Museum: Special Exhibition Opening
events.description: The Goethe House museum presents a new special exhibition exploring the life and works of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, Frankfurt's most famous son. Rare manuscripts, first editions, personal artifacts, portraits, and interactive digital installations.

events.title: Frankfurt Marathon Training Run — City Run Series
events.description: Official half-marathon training run through Frankfurt's city center, organized as a lead-up to the Frankfurt Marathon in October. Run past the Römer, along the Main riverbanks, and through the banking district. Water stations and pacers provided.
events.location: Start at Römer, Frankfurt (finish at Festhalle)

events.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt vs FC Augsburg
events.description: Eintracht Frankfurt's first home Bundesliga match of the 2026/27 season, hosting FC Augsburg at Deutsche Bank Park. The match kicks off the home campaign on Sunday 6 September 2026 at 17:30. Tickets available via the club's official channels.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurter Oktoberfest
events.description: Frankfurt's own Oktoberfest takes over the large Festhalle Hausmann tent at Deutsche Bank Park with Bavarian brass music, hearty food and lots of Schunkeln. Running from 9 September to 11 October 2026, it offers a Hessian-Bavarian mix of celebration. Tickets go on advance sale.
events.location: Festhalle Hausmann, Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Mainz Theatre: New Season Opening
events.description: Mainz State Theatre (Staatstheater Mainz) opens its new season with a premiere performance. World-class theatre, opera, and ballet in one of Germany's most beautiful historic theatres. The repertoire spans Shakespeare to contemporary German playwrights.

events.title: Herbst-Dippemess Frankfurt
events.description: Frankfurt's traditional autumn funfair returns to the Festplatz am Ratsweg with rides, apple wine, fairground food and a lively market. The autumn edition is cozier than the spring one but equally beloved by families. Runs daily from 11 to 27 September 2026.
events.location: Festplatz am Ratsweg, Eissporthalle, 60385 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Oper Frankfurt: Der Fliegende Holländer
events.description: Wagner's dramatic opera 'The Flying Dutchman' performed by the acclaimed Frankfurt Opera ensemble. A haunting tale of a cursed sea captain condemned to sail the oceans forever, and the woman whose love may redeem him. Stunning set design and world-class orchestral performance.

events.title: Tag des offenen Denkmals Frankfurt
events.description: On the European Heritage Open Days, historic monuments across Frankfurt open their doors free of charge, offering tours, workshops and behind-the-scenes access. This nationwide day takes place on Sunday 13 September 2026. A chance to discover hidden heritage sites across the city.
events.location: Various heritage sites across Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Interkulturelle Woche & Interkulturelles Fest Mainz
events.description: Mainz's Intercultural Week runs 11-20 September 2026 with encounters, talks, exhibitions and cultural dialogue. The highlight Intercultural Festival fills the Domplatz on Sunday 13 September with international food stalls, music and a real Kyrgyz yurt. Free and open to all.

events.title: Frankfurt English Theatre: New Season Opening
events.description: The English Theatre Frankfurt, one of Europe's largest English-language theatres, opens its new season. International casts perform contemporary English-language plays, classic dramas, and comedies. Pre-show dinner packages available.

events.title: Alte Oper Saisoneröffnung mit dem Treppenhausorchester
events.description: The Alte Oper Frankfurt opens its 2026/27 concert season with a free performance by the Treppenhausorchester, an ensemble known for innovative, surprising classical concepts. The venue's halls and foyers are filled with music from midday into the evening. This marks the start of a rich new concert season.
events.location: Alte Oper Frankfurt, Opernplatz 1, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Städel Museum: „Mary Magdalene. Sin. Pray. Love.“
events.description: Major special exhibition at the Städel Museum exploring the figure of Mary Magdalene in art from the Renaissance to the present. Runs from 17 September 2026 to 17 January 2027. Features paintings, sculptures and installations from the museum's collection and international loans.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Nacht der Museen — Museumsufer Night
events.description: The legendary Night of Museums across Frankfurt. Over 40 museums open their doors until 2 AM with a single ticket. Special guided tours by candlelight, live performances in every museum, experimental art installations, cocktail bars, DJ sets in gallery spaces, and shuttle buses connecting all venues. A cultural marathon.
events.cost_per_person: €15 (one ticket for all museums, includes shuttle bus)
events.location: All participating museums across Frankfurt (Museumsufer, Innenstadt, Bockenheim)

events.title: FRATOPIA – Festival der Entdeckungen
events.description: The Alte Oper Frankfurt transforms into a living sound-scape for five days with around 250 short concerts at free entry, from 15:00 until midnight each day. Visitors assemble their own personal programme across all halls and foyers. Runs 23-27 September 2026.
events.location: Alte Oper Frankfurt, Opernplatz 1, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Mainz leuchtet – Late Light Festival
events.description: Mainz's late light festival turns the city centre into a glowing work of art for three evenings, with buildings from the Rheingoldhalle to Schillerplatz illuminated by artistic light and video projections. Runs 24-26 September 2026. A magical, free after-dark experience for all ages.
events.location: City centre: Rheingoldhalle to Schillerplatz, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Oper Frankfurt: Premiere „La Vestale“ (Spontini)
events.description: Oper Frankfurt opens its 2026/27 season with the premiere of Gaspare Spontini's opera 'La Vestale', conducted by Carlo Rizzi and directed by Lydia Steier. A dramatic bel canto work about love and duty. The first performance takes place on 26 September 2026 in the Opera House.
events.location: Oper Frankfurt, Willy-Brandt-Platz 5-7, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurt Opera: New Season Opening Gala
events.description: Gala opening night of the Frankfurt Opera's new season. Black-tie event with a special program featuring highlights from the upcoming repertoire. Pre-show champagne reception in the foyer. One of Frankfurt's most glamorous cultural events.

events.title: Mainz Wine Autumn — Harvest Festival
events.description: Celebrate the grape harvest season in Mainz. Wine tastings of the new vintage, traditional Federweißer (young wine), Zwiebelkuchen (onion tart), and chestnut roasts. Live folk music, vineyard walks, and wine-growing demonstrations. Set along the autumn-coloured Rhine.

events.title: Jazz zum Dritten / Jazz on the Third
events.description: Frankfurt's open-air jazz festival on German Unity Day weekend transforms the Römerberg in the historic old town into a stage for outstanding jazz artists. On 3-4 October 2026, soulful ballads and energetic bebop alternate across the main stage. A celebration of Frankfurt's deep jazz heritage.

events.title: Staatstheater Mainz: Premiere „Lohengrin“ (Wagner)
events.description: The Staatstheater Mainz opens its 2026/27 music-theatre season with Richard Wagner's 'Lohengrin', conducted by Generalmusikdirektor Gabriel Venzago and staged by Erik Raskopf. The premiere takes place on 4 October 2026 in the Großes Haus. A grand romantic opera to open the new season.

events.title: Schirn Kunsthalle: Anna Hulačová (Guest Country Czechia)
events.description: Coinciding with Czechia's guest-of-honour appearance at the Frankfurt Book Fair, the Schirn focuses on the work of Czech artist Anna Hulačová for the first time in Germany. The exhibition opens in October 2026 and runs until 10 January 2027 at the Schirn's Bockenheim location.
events.location: Schirn Kunsthalle (Interim Bockenheim), Niddastraße 74, 60329 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse (Frankfurt Book Fair)
events.description: The world's largest trade fair for books and publishing runs from 7 to 11 October 2026 in Frankfurt, with the Czech Republic as guest of honour. Publishers, authors, agents and readers from over 100 countries gather for rights trading, debates and readings. Professional and public days are included.
events.location: Messe Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Deutsches Jazzfestival Frankfurt
events.description: Five days of world-class contemporary jazz from 13 to 17 October 2026 at venues across Frankfurt, organised by hr (Hessischer Rundfunk). The line-up includes Émile Parisien, Myra Melford, Louis Sclavis, Shake Stew, Emma Rawicz and more. The main concert series takes place in the hr-Sendesaal.

events.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse — World's Largest Book Fair
events.description: One of the world's largest and most prestigious book fairs. Meet authors, publishers, and literary agents from 100+ countries. Author readings, panel discussions, book signings, and special exhibitions. Guest of Honour country pavilion with cultural program. Public days on the weekend are a paradise for book lovers.

events.title: Frankfurt Marathon
events.description: One of Germany's largest city marathons through the streets of Frankfurt. Starts at the Festhalle, past the banking towers, along the Main riverbanks, through Sachsenhausen and the city centre. Live music at every kilometre. Charity relay teams, inline skating马拉松, and family fun run also available.

events.title: Mainova Frankfurt Marathon
events.description: Frankfurt's annual city marathon since 1981 takes place on Sunday 25 October 2026, with tens of thousands of runners on a flat, fast course along the Main and through the city centre. Events include the marathon, relay and a 10K. A highlight of the autumn sports calendar with great roadside atmosphere.
events.location: Start & Finish Festhalle, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Jazzkeller Frankfurt: November Jazz Series
events.description: Frankfurt's legendary Jazzkeller, one of Europe's most famous jazz clubs since 1952, presents its November concert series. Intimate basement venue that has hosted Miles Davis, Louis Armstrong, and Dizzy Gillespie. Features international touring artists and local talent. Late-night jam sessions after every concert.
events.location: Jazzkeller Frankfurt, Kleine Bockenheimer Straße 18a, 60313 Frankfurt

events.title: Frankfurt Christmas Market on Römerberg
events.description: One of Germany's oldest and most beautiful Christmas markets, dating back to 1393. Over 200 wooden stalls fill the Römerberg and Paulsplatz with handcrafted gifts, Christmas decorations, mulled wine (Glühwein), roasted almonds, candied fruits, and traditional Frankfurter Bethmännchen marzipan cookies. The giant Christmas tree in front of the Römer and the nightly light show make it magical.

events.title: Mainz Christmas Market
events.description: Mainz's charming Christmas market on the cathedral square. Over 100 stalls, an ice-skating rink in front of the majestic Mainz Cathedral, live nativity scene, children's craft workshops, and the famous Mainzer Glühwein. Historic carousel and weekly choir performances in the cathedral.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry (ice skating €6 incl. skate rental)

events.title: Mainz Carnival — Rosenmontag Parade
events.description: Mainz is one of Germany's three main carnival strongholds (alongside Cologne and Düsseldorf). The Mainz Rosenmontag parade features elaborately decorated floats, marching bands, costumed groups throwing sweets and flowers to the crowds. Carnival sessions (Sitzungen) with comedic speeches and performances run from November through February.
events.location: Mainz city centre (parade route along Große Bleiche, Schillerplatz, and around the Altstadt)

events.title: Frankfurt Ballet: The Nutcracker
events.description: Frankfurt Ballet's enchanting production of Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker at the Oper Frankfurt. A magical Christmas tradition for the whole family with stunning choreography, elaborate costumes, and a live orchestra performing the beloved score.

events.title: Jahrhunderthalle: Christmas Gala Concert
events.description: Festive Christmas gala concert at the historic Jahrhunderthalle Frankfurt. World-class orchestra, choir, and soloists perform classical Christmas masterpieces, traditional carols, and seasonal favorites. A highlight of Frankfurt's Christmas season.

events.title: Frankfurt Zoo: Winter Wonderland Light Trail
events.description: Frankfurt Zoo transforms into a winter wonderland with thousands of lights, illuminated animal sculptures, and a magical light trail through the grounds. Hot chocolate and roasted chestnuts available. A magical post-Christmas family outing.

events.title: New Year's Eve at Frankfurt Römer
events.description: Spectacular New Year's Eve celebration on Frankfurt's Römerberg square. Live music stage, food and mulled wine stalls, countdown on the giant LED screen, and a breathtaking midnight fireworks display launched from the Main River bridges. Tens of thousands gather to welcome the new year.
